facts.statement: Customers can return most items for a full refund within 30 days of the delivery date.
Proof of purchase can be the receipt, the order number, or the card the customer paid with.
facts.value: the receipt, the order number, or the card they paid with

facts.statement: Without proof of purchase, offer store credit for the current selling price instead of a refund.
facts.value: store credit for the current selling price

facts.statement: Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days after we receive the item.
Original shipping costs are not refunded, unless the item arrived damaged or we sent the wrong item.
facts.value: not refunded, unless the item arrived damaged or we sent the wrong item

facts.statement: Gift cards, custom-cut rope and chain, and opened fuel canisters cannot be returned.
facts.value: Gift cards, custom-cut rope and chain, opened fuel canisters

facts.statement: Customers can exchange an item in any store or by mail, using a prepaid return label for mail exchanges.
facts.value: in any store or by mail

facts.statement: If the new item costs more the customer pays the difference; if it costs less, the difference is refunded to the original payment method.
facts.value: customer pays the difference / difference refunded

facts.statement: Each purchased item can be exchanged once; a second exchange is handled as a return and a new purchase.
Escalate to Tier 2 after two failed fixes.
If the customer reports a safety issue with a product, escalate right away without trying fixes first.
To escalate, set the ticket priority and add the tag tier2, write a handoff note, and tell the customer a specialist will take over.
facts.value: tag tier2, handoff note, tell the customer

facts.statement: Tier 2 answers a standard escalation within 4 business hours.
Tier 2 answers a safety escalation within 1 hour, any time of day.
Refunds over $500 need a support manager to approve them before they are issued.
